title: Bisteckportz ModPack
description: A lightweight Fabric modpack that enhances the vanilla Minecraft experience with performance improvements, quality-of-life features, and carefully selected client-side enhancements.
body:
English

Bisteckportz ModPack is a lightweight Fabric modpack designed to improve the vanilla Minecraft experience without changing its core gameplay.

Features include:

Performance improvements for higher FPS.
Quality of Life enhancements.
Better multiplayer compatibility.
Small visual improvements while keeping the vanilla style.
Carefully selected client-side mods that don't affect vanilla servers.

The goal of this modpack is to make Minecraft smoother, cleaner and more enjoyable while preserving the original feeling of the game.

Italiano

Bisteckportz ModPack è un modpack Fabric leggero pensato per migliorare l'esperienza vanilla senza modificarne il gameplay.

Include:

ottimizzazioni delle prestazioni;
miglioramenti Quality of Life;
migliore esperienza multiplayer;
piccole migliorie grafiche;
mod client-side accuratamente selezionate.
